name: spomky-labs/access-control-lib
description: Authorization for PHP: decides whether a requester is allowed to perform an action on a subject.

suggest.symfony/expression-language: Required to use the expression voter and expression-based policies
suggest.symfony/security-core: Required to reuse the voters, the role hierarchy and the tokens of the Security component
suggest.twig/twig: Required to use the is_granted() and access_decision() template functions
